findings.title: Own and cancel every accepted H3 MASQUE connection
findings.cause: spawn_on detaches serve_connection tasks. Drop aborts only the accept task. Retained QUIC connection references keep the endpoint driver alive; EndpointRef Drop only wakes it.
findings.independent_contract: MasqueProxy documents abort on drop and close_connections closes every open outer connection.
